bio: Set in peaceful Pollokshields, Sherbrooke Castle provides opulent surroundings in which to indulge in a sumptuous Afternoon Tea. Treat yourself to a whole host of delicious treats at this magnificent building.  Originally built as baronial home in 1896, this decadent building has now been repurposed into a luxurious hotel. Afternoon Tea is served in the Restaurant, Lounge or Library that provides a suitably grand environment to indulge in the Great British tradition of Afternoon Tea.  Their quintessential menu features classic items including finger sandwiches, handmade cakes and scones. Guests feeling in a decadent mood can upgrade to include a glass of Prosecco or Champagne - please let your server know upon arrival if you would like this upgrade.  Sherbrooke Castle is situated in a prestigious residential area in Glasgow, just 10 minutes from the city centre and 15 minutes from Glasgow International Airport.  Please note that the venue requires a deposit of £10 per person to confirm the booking. A member of staff from the venue will contact you by phone to arrange the deposit payment.
